India Condemns US Temple Attack Plot, Cites Anti-India Hate

India has condemned an alleged plot by a 19-year-old man to carry out a mass shooting targeting a Hindu temple in Illinois, US. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) described the alleged anti-Hindu and racist nature of the plot as 'particularly disturbing' and flagged concerns over 'growing racist hostility and anti-India hate' in the US. India has sought a thorough investigation into the incident.
